create_hmdb51_dataset: create a LabeledVideoDataset for HMDB51 using the Hmdb51 helper function with a clip sampler and split config
load_hmdb51_paths_from_dir: load HMDB51 labeled video paths from a splits directory using Hmdb51LabeledVideoPaths.from_dir with split id and type
load_hmdb51_paths_from_csvs: load HMDB51 labeled video paths from a list of split text files using Hmdb51LabeledVideoPaths.from_csvs
set_hmdb51_path_prefix: set the video path prefix on an Hmdb51LabeledVideoPaths object to prepend a root directory to all video paths
review_hmdb51_split_types: review the Hmdb51LabeledVideoPaths class split type dictionary and allowed splits for train, test, and unused folds
